supplied.cycle: two-step running cycle, mirror-symmetric legs (left = right shifted half a cycle, roll/yaw sign-flipped), flight phase required (t_f >= 0.05 s)
supplied.stride_choice: among the ceiling model's feasible strides at v (its grid of t_c, t_f, h0; dz from spring-mass consistency), with t_c >= pi x 0.040 s (the stance force's half-sine inside the project actuator lag's -3 dB band; kept at 40 ms whatever the plant lag), t_f >= TF_MIN and t_f >= the knee's fold/unfold time (quintic peak rate and torque within KNEE_U of the rating): the stride with the largest actuator margin (min of the max over hip/knee of stance torque utilisation, stance speed/1.1, swing time/available)
supplied.swing_cart: (default, SWING_MODE=cart) ankle x relative to the hip: quintic from -Lc/2 (rate -v, continuous with the stance) to +Lc/2 with touchdown rate -beta v (beta = the largest of 1, .75, .5, .25, 0 whose inverse-dynamics hip/knee torques stay within KNEE_U of the rating; beta 1 = foot at rest on the ground at liftoff/touchdown); sole height above the floor: CLEAR x 64 s^3 (1-s)^3, the hip's height from the scaffold (other stance compression / ballistic flight), the leg never longer than at touchdown; soles level; numerical IK on the model
supplied.swing: (legacy joint-space modes) quintic thigh move liftoff->touchdown with the STANCE joint rates as boundary velocities (ground-speed matching: foot at rest on the ground at touchdown; thigh rate continuous at liftoff); knee folds to the ceiling's 3 cm floor-clearance angle during the first flight, stays folded while the other foot is down, unfolds during the last flight; soles level; foot under the hip laterally
supplied.compression: dz = g tf tc / (2 pi): the stance descent rate at touchdown equals the flight landing speed (spring-mass consistency; the ceiling's half-sine force impulse then equals m g T exactly)
supplied.feedforward: inverse dynamics of the swing and upper-body reference on the model (base at v with the scaffold's vertical acceleration, no contact; zero for a stance leg and while waiting for a touchdown), advanced by ACT_TAU
supplied.stance: FORCE CONTROL of a loaded stance leg (load-weighted): F_z = m (g + dz (pi/t_c)^2 sin) + m (K_z (z_ref - z) + D_z (vz_ref - vz)), K_z = (pi/t_c)^2, D_z = 2 pi/t_c; F_xy directed from the foot at the COM and tilted by the attitude moment (M_x = h dF_y, M_y = -h dF_x); residual moment to the CoP clipped to the sole polygon and |M_z| <= 0.05 F_z; |F_xy| <= 0.8 F_z; tau = -J^T [F; M] through the model's foot Jacobian; the leg's joint PD scaled by 0.1
supplied.trunk_arms: trunk held at the keyframe; ARMS: antiphase shoulder-pitch swing that cancels the FUNDAMENTAL (cycle-frequency harmonic) of the legs' yaw angular momentum about the COM over the reference cycle (w_sp = -L_z1 / dL_z/dw_sp); the search refines both through knots
supplied.feedback: Raibert: placement (about the COM's neutral point: + COM-ahead-of-hips offset) dx=(vx-v)(tc/2+sqrt(h/g)) with the instantaneous COM vx (constant in flight), dy=vy(tc/2+sqrt(h/g)) with vy averaged over one step (the sway), latched at touchdown and released through the stance; attitude servo in the stance force: moment about the COM M = -I_c (om^2 (attitude - (lean,0,0)) + 2 om pelvis rate), I_c = composite inertia about the COM, om = min(pi/t_c, 0.5/ACT_TAU); swing-leg hip targets corrected for the actual pelvis attitude (world-frame placement)
supplied.lag_comp: the tracked reference and the feedforward are advanced by ACT_TAU (the known actuator lag); the feedback terms act on the state predicted ACT_TAU ahead (q + qdot tau, COM + v tau, attitude + rate tau)
supplied.tracker: PD per joint, omega 25.0 legs / 20.0 upper, zeta 1, I_eff = the joint's diagonal of the model's mass matrix (locked-chain inertia)
supplied.clock: event-synchronised cycle phase: advances with time, held at each scheduled touchdown until the expected foot lands (after >= 20 ms unloaded), jumps to the touchdown phase if that foot lands up to t_f + 0.25 t_c early (earlier contacts are scuffs); both legs' stance/swing follow it
supplied.gates: envelope+backemf+OVERSPEED 1.1, actuator lag ACT_TAU (see act_tau), energy closure, no non-foot floor contact, slip <= 0.03 m/stance, no fall, periodic over cycles 2..12 at 1 ms and 0.5 ms; tolerances {'z': 0.02, 'pitch': 0.05, 'roll': 0.05, 'q': 0.08, 'qd': 1.5, 'vx': 0.1}
supplied.start_momentum: base velocity solved so the COM moves at (v, -dvy/2, 0) and the angular momentum about the COM is zero
supplied.start_sway: initial lateral COM velocity -dvy/2, dvy = g T y_off / h (the scaffold's periodic sway with feet under the hips)
supplied.friction: MuJoCo pyramidal cone, condim 3, mu = 1.0 (model values)
supplied.stride_def: stride = one gait cycle = two steps

stride.rule: max actuator margin among strides whose flight fits the knee fold/unfold
